type-system.twistDescription: Vocal Intelligence — proprietary SF Pro stack replaced with web-accessible Plus Jakarta Sans (display) + Inter (UI/text). All fonts served via Google Fonts CDN. Extraction artifact corrected: p was a duplicate of h3 at 64px/600, corrected to proper paragraph style at 18px/400.

motion-system.twistDescription: Stagger delay introduction (Twist E, intensity 3 = 0.1s step). Three repeating selector groups (.interactive-opacity, .s-full, .text-button/.text-base) now cascade with 0.1s incremental delays per occurrence, transforming uniform simultaneous transitions into a rhythmic sequential reveal.

grid-system.twistDescription: Gap value scaling at ×1.4 (Twist B, intensity 3). Header grid gap scaled from 40px to 56px; responsive breakpoint (810px) columnGap and rowGap scaled from 45px to 63px. Opens editorial breathing room.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Button padding shift wider +16px horizontal (Twist D, intensity 4). Original horizontal padding was 18px; new value is 34px. Pill border-radius (500px) preserved. All other element spacing unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Hover transition speed slowed — all 0.3s hover transitions increased by +0.15s to 0.45s across buttons, links, and navigation (Twist A, intensity 3). Makes interactions feel more deliberate. No color values changed.

nav-system.twistDescription: Item spacing expanded by +10px (Twist E, intensity 3). Original itemSpacing was 3.875px — extremely tight for a luxury fashion nav. Spread to 13.875px for editorial breathing room. Center-logo layout preserved.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Kinetic shift applied to 'Design System Signals Across Sections' paragraph (Twist A). Reframed design consistency as active tension — warm palette pushing against cold field, letterforms carrying kinetic charge, absent UI components building forward pressure by refusal. concept_by_video.md generated from scratch with ambient persistence as central motion principle.

consistencyChecks.colorContrast: PASS — dark background (#19191c, brightness 25) vs mid-grey text (#acacaf, brightness 172) — sufficient contrast
consistencyChecks.motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — motion durations 0.2–0.5s, hover transitions 0.45s, max ratio 2.25× (under 5× threshold)
consistencyChecks.navFontAvailability: PASS — nav.json has no typography.fontFamily field, effectively inherits from type-system
